Vivek / Marissa / Peter — did a quick pass on the numbers from the plan. Short summary:
- If baseline is sustained 3k RPS with median 420 tokens/call -> ~1.08M tokens/hr. That number seems off for median; I think Peter meant 420 tokens per *session* and sessions will batch. Using the conservative approach (3k RPS * 420 tokens * 36h) gives ~45.36M tokens total — which is large.
- More realistic split: 3k peak with average concurrent profile yields ~1.5M–2.0M tokens for the 36h window.

Recommendation: provision a 2M token voucher + an emergency 1M token safety buffer. Also reserve a 36h burst window on the Dedicated pool for Sep 18 22:00–Sep 19 10:00 UTC (we can compress the high-traffic hours if needed).

Attached calc (credit_calc.xlsx) with the assumptions. If Edgelytics will target a quantized 13B variant we can reduce unit cost by ~45% compared to the 70B.

Jonas
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
